words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.ex: He goes to bed at nine every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上九点上床睡觉。
words.en: To go to bed means to lie down in a bed in order to sleep.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.ex: Children go to school every day.
words.en: To attend an educational institution for the purpose of learning.

words.tr: phrase. 铺床；整理床铺；自作自受（比喻意义）
words.ex: Every morning, he makes his bed before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，他在吃早餐前都会整理床铺。
words.en: To arrange the sheets, blankets, and pillows on a bed so that it is neat and ready for someone to sleep in. It can also mean to accept the consequences of one's actions.

words.ex: He takes a shower every morning.
words.en: To wash oneself in a shower.

words.ex: I wash my hands before eating.
words.en: To clean something using water and usually soap.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: She attends an after-school art class.
words.ex_cn: 她参加一个课外美术班。
words.en: After-school is used to describe activities that take place after the school day has ended.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: The firefighter saved a dog from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从着火的房子里救出了一只狗。
words.en: A firefighter is a person whose job is to extinguish fires and rescue people from dangerous situations.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.ex: The book is interesting.
words.en: If something is interesting, it attracts your attention, because it is unusual, exciting, or has lots of ideas.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.tr: 名词短语，表示距离为50公里
words.ex: The town is 50 km from the city.
words.en: Fifty kilometers, a unit of distance equal to approximately 31 miles.

words.ex: The school is five kilometres from my house.
words.en: A kilometre is a unit of length equal to 1,000 metres, or approximately 0.621 miles.

words.ex: I do not like spinach at all.
words.en: Used to emphasize that you are not in the least bit tired, interested, etc.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.ex: He practises piano every day.
words.en: To do something repeatedly in order to improve your skill at it.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: He works as a firefighter and loves firefighting.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名消防员，热爱消防工作。
words.en: The activity or profession of extinguishing fires.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: If it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: You use if in conditional sentences to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.

words.ex: I like tea or coffee.
words.en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.ex: I have to go to school every day.
words.en: If you have to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力而为；竭尽全力
words.ex: I will try my best to finish the homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to achieve something.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: The news was false.
words.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.ex: He rides his bicycle to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.tr: adj. 糟糕的；坏的；严重的；
words.ex: The weather today is bad.
words.en: If you describe something as bad, you mean that it is of a low or unacceptable standard or quality.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.tr:
v. 停留；保持；
n. 停留；逗留；
words.ex: He will stay at home tonight.
words.en: To stay means to continue to be in a particular place or situation, or to remain in a specified state or condition.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有道理；说得对
words.ex: You have a point about saving money.
words.ex_cn: 你关于存钱的说法有道理。
words.en: If someone has a point, what they say is reasonable or correct, especially when they are disagreeing with you.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.ex: Stay away from the dog; it is angry.
words.ex_cn: 离那只狗远点，它很生气。
words.en: To avoid going near someone or something, especially because it is dangerous or could cause problems.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.ex: I will do it in a minute.
words.en: Used to indicate that something will happen very soon.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.ex: The concert was wonderful.
words.en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

words.ex: He put the food on a clean dish.
words.ex_cn: 他把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A dish is a shallow container used for cooking or serving food.

words.ex: He has a big nose.
words.en: The part of the face or head that contains the nostrils and organs of smell and through which a person or animal breathes.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr: phrase. 即时消息；即时通讯
words.ex: He sent an instant message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友发了一条即时消息。
words.en: An instant message is a short message that is sent and read in real time using the internet.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.ex: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周都收到朋友的一封信。
words.en: To get or be given something; to welcome someone officially or socially.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.ex: He slept for a while.
words.en: For a period of time; not permanently.

words.ex: Hey, can you help me with this?
words.en: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or annoyance

words.tr:
adj. 缓慢的；迟钝的；
v. 使减速；
words.ex: The slow car moved across the bridge.
words.en: Moving or capable of moving only at a low speed; not fast.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: He waits for the bus at the bus stop.
words.en: A place on a bus route where buses regularly stop to pick up and drop off passengers.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: He went to the police station to report a theft.
words.en: A police station is the office of a local police force, where the police work and where people can report crimes.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.tr: n. 方式；道路；方向；路线；方法；
words.ex: He found a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方式。
words.en: A way is a method, style, or manner of doing something, or a route or path that you take to get from one place to another.

words.ex: Please excuse me for being late.
words.en: To excuse someone means to forgive them for something they have done wrong or to allow them not to do something that they should do.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.ex: He eats a banana every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: He eats a grape every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗葡萄。
words.en: A grape is a small, round fruit that grows in bunches on a vine. Grapes can be green, red, or purple and are used for making wine, eating fresh, or drying into raisins.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.ex: She ate a ripe pear for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个熟透的梨当零食。
words.en: A pear is a sweet, juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom. It has a thin green or brown skin, and white flesh.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.tr:
n. 水果；
v. 结果实；
words.ex: I like fruit.
words.en: The edible part of a plant that develops from a flower, especially one that is sweet and contains seeds.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.ex: He paid one dollar for the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一美元买这个苹果。
words.en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the United States, Canada, Australia, and some other countries.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.ex: The apple weighs one kilogramme.
words.en: A kilogramme is a unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2046 pounds.

words.ex: The bag weighs 5 kg.
words.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: The unit price of apples is $2 per kilo.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的单价是每公斤2美元。
words.en: The price of a single item or measure of something, especially when part of a larger quantity.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.tr: phrase. 热狗（面包夹熏红肠）
words.ex: He eats a hot dog at the park.
words.en: A hot dog is a cooked sausage, traditionally grilled or steamed and served in a sliced bun as a sandwich.

words.ex: He eats ice cream after dinner.
words.en: A sweet, creamy frozen food made from milk fat, sugar, and flavorings.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.ex: Thank you, sir.
words.en: A polite or formal way of addressing a man, especially one whose name you do not know or a man of higher rank or status.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: She ate a cookie after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她在午饭后吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round and flat, that is baked and often served as a snack.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of noodle for lunch.
words.en: Noodles are a type of food made from unleavened dough which is rolled flat and cut, stretched or extruded, into long strips or strings.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr: phrase. 值得深思的想法或信息；引人思考的内容
words.ex: His speech gave us food for thought.
words.en: If something is described as providing food for thought, it is worth thinking about or considering seriously.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr: n. 游泳运动员；游泳者；
words.ex: He is a fast swimmer who won the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名速度快的游泳运动员，赢得了金牌。
words.en: A swimmer is a person who swims, especially as a sport or regularly for exercise.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾食品；无营养食品
words.ex: He eats junk food every day.
words.en: Food that is unhealthy but is quick and easy to eat.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.ex: The birds fly south in winter.
words.en: Winter is the season between autumn and spring. In the winter, the weather is usually cold.

words.ex: The water in the pond is cloudy.
words.en: If it is cloudy, there are a lot of clouds in the sky.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.ex: It was a rainy day, so we stayed inside.
words.ex_cn: 那天是多雨的，所以我们待在室内。
words.en: If the weather is rainy, it is raining a lot.

words.ex: The snowy mountains look beautiful in winter.
words.ex_cn: 多雪的山在冬天看起来很美。
words.en: Covered with snow; resembling snow in whiteness or texture.

words.tr: adj. 阳光灿烂的；晴朗的；
words.ex: It is a sunny day today.
words.ex_cn: 今天是阳光灿烂的一天。
words.en: When it is sunny, the sun is shining brightly.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.ex: It is a windy day today.
words.en: If it is windy, the wind is blowing a lot.

words.ex: He will return next month.
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: He was born in January.
words.en: January is the first month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: My birthday is in February.
words.en: February is the second month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars.

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.ex: She was born in April.
words.en: The fourth month of the year, in the northern hemisphere usually considered the second month of spring.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.ex: We will go to the beach in June.
words.en: the sixth month of the year, in the northern hemisphere usually considered the first month of summer

words.ex: He was born in August.
words.en: August is the eighth month of the Gregorian calendar, following July and preceding September.

words.ex: He was born in September.
words.en: September is the ninth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar, coming after August and before October.

words.ex: He was born in October.
words.en: October is the tenth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: He was born in November.
words.en: November is the eleventh month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: My birthday is in December.
words.en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars and the seventh and last of seven months to have a length of 31 days.

words.tr:
v. 穿；戴；
n. 磨损；衣着；
words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: If you wear something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery, you have them on your body or on part of your body.

words.ex: He wears a black overcoat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件黑色大衣。
words.en: An overcoat is a long warm coat that you wear over your other clothes in cold weather.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: The ground is covered with snow.
words.en: Snow is the small, soft, white pieces of ice that sometimes fall from the sky when it is cold.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr:
v. 飞翔；飞行；
n. 苍蝇；
words.ex: Birds fly in the sky.
words.en: To move through the air using wings; or a small insect with two wings.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.ex: He wears shorts to the beach.
words.en: Shorts are a piece of clothing that you wear on the lower part of your body, which do not cover your legs completely.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.tr:
adj. 干的；
v. 变干；
words.ex: The cloth is dry after the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在阳光下晒干了。
words.en: If something is dry, there is no water or moisture on it or in it.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.ex: The green leaf fell from the tree.
words.en: A leaf is one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr: adj. 五彩缤纷的；丰富多彩的；
words.ex: The children painted a colourful picture.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了一幅五彩缤纷的画。
words.en: Something that is colourful has bright colours or a lot of different colours.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.en: The star around which the earth orbits, providing light and warmth.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；
words.ex: I will go to school tomorrow.
words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: We walked on the beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform along the coast of an ocean, sea, lake, or river. It usually consists of loose particles, which are often composed of rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.ex: The visitor took photos of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位参观者拍了博物馆的照片。
words.en: A visitor is someone who is visiting a person or place.

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.ex: He finished in eighth place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第八名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number eight in a series.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.tr:
adj. 第五的；
n. 五分之一；第五；
adv. 第五；
words.ex: He finished in fifth place.
words.en: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

words.ex: He finished in the ninth position.
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number nine in a series.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr: adj. 令人激动的；使人兴奋的； v. “excite”的现在分词；
words.ex: The football match was exciting.
words.en: If something is exciting, it makes you feel very happy or enthusiastic.

words.tr:
adj. 第四的；
n. 第四个；
adv. 第四；
words.ex: He finished in fourth place.
words.en: The fourth item in a series is the one that you count as number four.

words.ex: He finished in seventh place.
words.en: The seventh item in a series is the one that you count as number seven.

words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: I write letters to my penfriend in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我给我在加拿大的笔友写信。
words.en: A penfriend is someone you write friendly letters to on a regular basis, especially someone in another country whom you have never met.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: He sent a postcard from Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他从巴黎寄了一张明信片。
words.en: A postcard is a piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically rectangular, intended for writing and mailing without an envelope and at a lower rate than a letter.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: They lived in a fairy-tale world full of magic and wonder.
words.ex_cn: 他们生活在一个充满魔法与奇迹的神话世界里。
words.en: A fairy-tale is a story for children involving magical events and imaginary creatures.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.ex: He likes to skate on the ice every winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每年冬天在冰上溜冰。
words.en: To move over a surface on skates, or to perform a sport that involves moving on skates.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.tr:
adj. 第六的；六分之一的；
n. 第六；六分之一；
words.ex: He lives on the sixth floor.
words.en: The sixth item in a series is the one that you count as number six.

words.tr:
n. 十分之一；第十；
adj. 第十的；
words.ex: He ate a tenth of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了蛋糕的十分之一。
words.en: The tenth item in a series is the one that you count as number ten.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.ex: The floor is dirty after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，地板变得肮脏了。
words.en: If something is dirty, it is marked or covered with stains, spots, or mud, and needs to be cleaned.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr:
adv. 远；极；
adj. 较远的；遥远的；
words.ex: He ran far from the house.
words.en: At, to, or by a great distance (used to indicate the extent to which one thing is distant from another).

words.ex: He returned to his hometown after graduation.
words.en: Your hometown is the town or city where you were born or grew up.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: My neighbour gives me apples from his tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从他的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbour is someone who lives near you, especially in the next house or flat.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr:
adv. 昨天；
n. 昨天；
words.ex: I saw her yesterday.
words.en: The day before today.

words.tr: phrase. 快餐店；提供快速服务的餐饮场所
words.ex: He eats lunch at a fast-food restaurant.
words.en: A fast-food restaurant is a specific type of restaurant characterized by food that is supplied quickly after ordering, and by minimal table service.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: I saw him two days ago.
words.en: If something happened a particular length of time ago, it is that length of time since it happened.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: The child ate a piece of candy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后吃了一块糖果。
words.en: Candy is a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate, often eaten as a treat.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.ex: He is afraid of the dark.
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: He became angry when his phone broke.
words.ex_cn: 当他手机坏了时，他生气了。
words.en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋的； v. 使兴奋；使激动；“excite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were excited about the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对派对感到兴奋。
words.en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, usually because you are thinking about something pleasant that you are going to do or experience.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.tr: n. （用于女子的姓氏或姓名前，不指明婚否）女士
words.ex: Ms. Li is our new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 李女士是我们新来的老师。
words.en: a title used before the surname or full name of a woman regardless of her marital status

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；喊叫；
v. 哭；哭泣；
words.ex: His cry woke up the whole house.
words.ex_cn: 他的哭泣惊醒了整个房子。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.tr:
adj. 响亮的；大声的；
adv. 大声地；
words.ex: The music was too loud at the party.
words.en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr: phrase. 初级中学（通常指7至9年级）
words.ex: He goes to junior high school near his house.
words.ex_cn: 他去家附近的一所初中。
words.en: A school intermediate between elementary school and high school, typically including grades seven through nine.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.en: If you pay attention to someone or something, you watch, listen to, or think about them carefully.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: He is proud of his son's good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子的好成绩感到自豪。
words.en: Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.tr: 短语. 处于困境中；惹上麻烦
words.ex: He is in trouble for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 他因为打碎了窗户而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: To be in a situation where one is likely to suffer adverse consequences or to be in difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: I am glad to see you.
words.en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He shouted loudly to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声喊叫以引起注意。
words.en: In a way that produces or is capable of producing much noise; not quietly.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: I buy apples at the market.
words.en: To buy means to obtain something by paying money for it.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: He gave me a suggestion to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提了一个多吃蔬菜的建议。
words.en: A suggestion is an idea or plan that someone puts forward for consideration.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: He explained the problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, read, or understand.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The farmer milks the cow every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上给母牛挤奶。
words.en: A cow is a large female animal that is kept on farms for its milk.

words.ex: The duck swims in the pond.
words.en: A duck is a bird that lives by water and has webbed feet, a short neck, and a large flat beak. As a verb, to duck means to lower the head or body quickly to avoid being hit or seen.

words.ex: The elephant walks slowly in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 大象在动物园里慢慢走。
words.en: An elephant is a very large animal with a long trunk, large ears, and two long curved tusks. Elephants are found in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。
words.en: A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck and legs and pale brown fur with dark spots. Giraffes are the tallest living land animals.

words.ex: The hen is laying eggs in the coop.
words.en: A hen is a female chicken, especially one that is kept for its eggs.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: The monkey is eating a banana.
words.en: A monkey is a small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail, most kinds of which live in trees in tropical countries.

words.ex: The panda is eating bamboo in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊猫在动物园里吃竹子。
words.en: A panda is a large, black-and-white bear-like mammal native to China, known for its distinctive markings and diet consisting almost entirely of bamboo.

words.ex: The penguin walks on the ice.
words.en: A penguin is a type of bird that cannot fly, lives in the southern hemisphere, and swims very well.

words.ex: The pig is eating food in the yard.
words.en: A pig is a farm animal with short legs, a fat body, and a curved tail. Pigs are kept for their meat, which is called pork.

words.ex: The sheep graze quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 绵羊在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A sheep is a farm animal which is covered with thick curly hair called wool. Sheep are kept for their wool or for their meat.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.tr:
n. 农场；农庄；
v. 耕种；
words.ex: He works on a small farm with cows and chickens.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个养牛和鸡的小农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.ex: The mouse ran under the table.
words.en: A mouse is a small animal with a long tail, which is found in houses and fields and is often kept as a pet. In computing, a mouse is a small device that you move across a surface in order to move a cursor on your computer screen.

words.ex: The snake crawled slowly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中缓慢地爬行。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
