words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He hurt his body while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤到了身体。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.tr:
n. 眼睛；
v. 注视；审视；
words.ex: He hurt his eye in the game.
words.en: The organ of sight in humans and animals, typically one of a pair, which is sensitive to light and enables vision.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He can solve the problem easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易就能解决这个问题。
words.en: Without difficulty or effort.

words.ex: He walks one mile to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行一英里去学校。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 1,760 yards (approximately 1.609 kilometers).

words.tr: v. 放置；安放；下蛋；“lie”的过去式； adj. 外行的；非专业的；
words.ex: He lay the book on the table.
words.en: To put something down gently or carefully.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.ex: The boy rides a horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上骑马。
words.en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.tr: adv. 快乐地；幸福地；幸运地；
words.ex: She smiled happily when she got the gift.
words.ex_cn: 她收到礼物时快乐地笑了。
words.en: In a happy manner; with happiness.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: I recognised my old friend at the station.
words.ex_cn: 我在车站认出了我的老朋友。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.tr: adv. 温暖地；热心地；热烈地
words.ex: She warmly welcomed her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她热情地欢迎她的朋友。
words.en: In a way that shows enthusiasm, affection, or kindness.

words.ex: I believe you are telling the truth.
words.en: If you believe in something, you think that it is true, or that it exists.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: Children can play freely in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们可以在公园里自由地玩耍。
words.en: If you can do something freely, you can do it without being controlled or restricted by anyone.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.ex: The parrot can say hello.
words.en: A parrot is a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly colored feathers. Parrots are often kept as pets because they can be taught to copy human speech.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.tr: n. 树袋熊；考拉熊；无尾熊；
words.ex: The koala sleeps in a eucalyptus tree.
words.en: A koala is an Australian arboreal marsupial that has thick grey fur and feeds on eucalyptus leaves.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: He lives in the united states.
words.en: The United States is a country in North America, consisting of 50 states, a federal district, five major self-governing territories, and various possessions.

words.tr: phrase. 香港（中国的一个特别行政区）
words.ex: He lives in Hong Kong.
words.en: A Special Administrative Region of China, known for its skyline and deep natural harbor.

words.ex: He lives in London.
words.en: London is the capital city of England and the United Kingdom, known for its history, culture, and financial services.

words.ex: He is from the UK.
words.en: The United Kingdom, a sovereign state in northwestern Europe.

words.tr: phrase. 联合王国（指英国，全称为大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国）
words.ex: He lives in the United Kingdom.
words.en: The United Kingdom is a country in northwestern Europe, consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

words.tr: n. 兵工厂；武器库；军械库；
words.ex: The old arsenal now serves as a museum.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧兵工厂现在被用作博物馆。
words.en: An arsenal is a place where weapons and military equipment are stored or made.

words.ex: Many tourists visit the Great Wall every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年许多游客参观长城。
words.en: The Great Wall refers to the ancient Chinese fortifications built to protect and consolidate territories of Chinese states and empires against various nomadic groups of the steppe and their polities.

words.tr: 专有名词。天安门广场（位于中国北京市中心，是世界上最大的城市广场之一）
words.ex: Many tourists visit Tian'anmen Square every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都有许多游客参观天安门广场。
words.en: Tian'anmen Square is a large city square in the center of Beijing, China, named after the Tiananmen (Gate of Heavenly Peace) located to its north, separating it from the Forbidden City.

words.tr: phrase. 夏宫；避暑行宫（尤指中国北京的颐和园）
words.ex: They visited the Summer Palace last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了颐和园。
words.en: A summer palace is a palace used by a ruler or other important person as a summer residence, often located in a cooler, more scenic area than the main residence.

words.tr: phrase. 香山公园（位于中国北京，以秋季红叶闻名）
words.ex: We walked in Fragrant Hills Park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去了香山公园散步。
words.en: A famous scenic area in Beijing, China, known for its autumn foliage.

words.ex: He lives in New York.
words.en: New York is a city in the United States known for its cultural diversity, financial significance, and iconic landmarks such as the Statue of Liberty and Times Square.

words.ex: She lives in Sydney.
words.en: Sydney is a major city in Australia, known for its harbourfront Opera House with a distinctive sail-like design, and the massive Darling Harbour and the smaller Circular Quay port, hubs of waterside life.

words.ex: The ancient statue was made of terracotta.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代雕像由赤陶制成。
words.en: Terracotta is a type of fired clay, typically of a brownish-red color and unglazed, used as an ornamental building material and in modeling.

words.tr: phrase. 故宫博物院；宫殿博物馆
words.ex: They visited the Palace Museum last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天参观了故宫博物院。
words.en: The Palace Museum, located in the heart of Beijing, China, is a historic site that was once the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties. It is now a museum that showcases the rich history and culture of China, housing an extensive collection of artifacts and artworks from the imperial era.

words.ex: The bird built its nest in the tree.
words.en: A bird's nest is a structure built by birds to hold their eggs and provide a place for their young to develop.

words.tr: phrase. 石林（由大量石灰岩柱状结构组成的自然地貌，如中国云南石林）
words.ex: Tourists visit the stone forest to see strange rock shapes.
words.ex_cn: 游客来到石林观看奇特的岩石形状。
words.en: A stone forest is a type of karst landform consisting of a large number of tall, narrow, limestone columns that resemble a forest made of stone.

words.tr: phrase. 天湖（常用于地名，如长白山天池）
words.ex: Heaven's lake is a beautiful place in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 天湖是山中一个美丽的地方。
words.en: A scenic lake in Xinjiang, China, also known as Tianchi.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.
